references.text: The main account of when the earth opened up and swallowed Korah, Dathan, and Abiram along with their families and possessions.
Describes how fire went out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering incense.
The introduction to Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron, which led to divine punishment.
Moses reminds the Israelites of what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram when the earth opened up and swallowed them.
The psalm tells of how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, covered Abiram's group, and fire burned up the wicked.
The daughters of Zelophehad mention that their father was not among those who gathered together against the Lord in Korah's group.
Jude's letter warns against those who perished in Korah's rebellion as a cautionary example.
